description: Canonical clinical-trial-agreement semantic normalization taxonomy; aliases are candidate retrieval cues, not literal substitution rules.

net_days.definition: integer days to pay an invoice, e.g. 30
semantic_hints: within 30 days of receipt of invoice
days after receipt of an undisputed invoice

start_up_fee_pct.definition: start-up fee as a percent of the study budget, number only, e.g. 15
semantic_hints: initiation milestone as a percentage of total budget
start-up payment credited against later fees
advance repaid if study does not begin

survival_years.definition: years confidentiality survives after study close, number
semantic_hints: nondisclosure obligations survive completion for five years
remain in effect for five years after expiration
period following termination in which confidential information is protected

trade_secrets_perpetual.definition: true or false: trade secrets stay protected with no end date
semantic_hints: trade secrets remain confidential for so long as protected by law
trade secret obligations survive in perpetuity
no time limitation on trade secret protection
except to the extent caused by negligent acts or omissions
except for gross negligence or willful misconduct
arising out of wrongful or negligent acts
excluded to the extent resulting from institution misconduct

adjudication_required.definition: true or false: carve-out applies only once finally adjudicated
semantic_hints: finally adjudicated by a court of competent jurisdiction
liable only after final determination of fault

mutual_indemnity.definition: true or false: site's indemnity becomes mutual / sponsor must be indemnified in turn
semantic_hints: each party agrees to indemnify the other
travel expenses associated with injury treatment
sponsor pays without first seeking insurance
not required to submit claim to insurance

review_days.definition: integer days the sponsor has to review a publication
semantic_hints: submitted for review 30 days before publication
at least 40 days before forwarding publication
review and comment upon a proposed manuscript

review_window_open_ended.definition: true or false: a qualifier like 'or as otherwise agreed' makes the window open-ended
semantic_hints: review period may be extended by mutual agreement
within such other period as sponsor requires
delay publication to permit patent filing
right to request patent filing postponement
right to publish without any patent filing delay

patent_delay_days.definition: integer days of extra delay for patent filings
semantic_hints: additional 60 days to file patent applications
delay publication for up to 120 days to secure intellectual property
vest automatically upon creation in sponsor

site_research_license.definition: true or false: site keeps a non-exclusive research license
semantic_hints: non-exclusive royalty-free license for institution research
perpetual right to use inventions for noncommercial research
site retains internal teaching and research rights
retained royalty-free noncommercial license to inventions

background_ip_retained.definition: true or false: each party keeps its background IP
semantic_hints: each party retains pre-existing intellectual property
background IP remains sole property of institution
prior inventions not affected by agreement
no ownership transfer of background technology

requires_baa.definition: true or false: sponsor must sign a business associate agreement
semantic_hints: sponsor must execute HIPAA business associate contract

blocks_secondary_research.definition: true or false: sponsor may not use data for secondary research
semantic_hints: only for purposes of the study

data_use_addendum.definition: true or false: sponsor signs a limited data-use addendum

ml_training_restriction.definition: true or false: limits on using study data to train AI/ML models
semantic_hints: no training of machine learning models
cannot use study data to develop algorithms
limits reuse of protected data for artificial intelligence

site_notice_days.definition: integer days' notice the institution must give to terminate
semantic_hints: institution may terminate on 30 days prior written notice
either party may terminate by giving thirty days written notice
site termination effective 30 days after notice

sponsor_notice_days.definition: integer days' notice the sponsor must give to terminate
semantic_hints: sponsor may terminate on 30 days prior written notice
company may terminate without cause upon notice
funding agency gives advance written notice

termination_for_convenience.definition: true or false: site may terminate for convenience
semantic_hints: institution may terminate with or without cause
either party can terminate for any reason

pays_noncancellable_costs.definition: true or false: sponsor still pays non-cancellable costs on termination
semantic_hints: non-cancelable commitments incurred prior to termination
outstanding obligations that cannot be cancelled

governing_law_state.definition: the state or country whose law governs, e.g. Wisconsin
semantic_hints: applicable law of the State or Territory in which the Institution is located
construed in accordance with governing law
consent to personal jurisdiction and venue

arbitration_abroad.definition: true or false: mandatory arbitration outside the US
semantic_hints: mandatory binding arbitration in another country
arbitration shall be held outside the United States

sovereign_immunity_waiver_required.definition: true or false: sponsor must waive or accept the site's sovereign immunity terms
semantic_hints: acceptance of public institution statutory protections

institution_is_public.definition: true or false: the institution is a public (state) institution
semantic_hints: agency of the State of Connecticut
public entity entitled to governmental immunity protections
constituent unit of a state university

no_substantive_change.definition: true when the edit only fixes typos, formatting or numbering and does not change any right or obligation
semantic_hints: clerical correction without any substantive change

guardrails: Recognize parties by function, not just labels: in investigator-initiated trials the Institution can be the Sponsor-Investigator and an external company may be called Company or Funding Agency.
Field aliases retrieve candidate clauses; only contextual interpretation determines field value. Handle negation, provisos, exceptions, references, and compound obligations.
Do not turn an absent clause into false, 0, none, removed, or uncapped. Use status=not_mentioned and value=null.
Do not equate HIPAA Authorization, patient informed consent, privacy law compliance, and a Business Associate Agreement. BAA requires BAA language.
Mention of trade secrets inside a definition does NOT prove perpetual confidentiality obligations.
A clause providing medical care costs does NOT itself cover lost wages, pain and suffering, or travel.
Indemnity for third-party claims is distinct from reimbursement of subject treatment expenses.
Study-use-only language about Sponsor confidential information is not automatically a restriction on secondary research use of Study Data.
A public institution preserving its own sovereign immunity is not the same as requiring the Sponsor to waive its immunity.
Adjudication mentioned elsewhere (e.g., defense counsel fees or liability determination) does NOT mean the indemnity carve-out itself is adjudication-gated.
Invention ownership may vary by invention class. Return ambiguous or conditional with evidence rather than choosing one of sponsor/institution/joint arbitrarily.
Retaining institution background IP does NOT mean site has a non-exclusive research license to newly created study IP.
Venue, governing law, and arbitration are distinct concepts; Australian state/territory clauses are not US state clauses.
Termination for material breach or patient safety is NOT termination for convenience. Record the notice period and termination trigger together.
A rate limit (e.g. 150% of Medicare) is a cap; a general budget limit is not necessarily a cap on subject injury reimbursement.
Publication review, patent-related publication delay, and multi-center publication embargo are separate timelines.
The patent_delay enum retained/removed is redline-relative; from a standalone template, extract whether a patent delay exists and its length, but do not claim language was removed.
A mutually agreed review extension is not necessarily an indefinite unilateral sponsor veto; inspect the exact approval requirement.
no_substantive_change is a property of a comparison/redline; a single unsigned template cannot establish it.
Templates establish vocabulary/examples but not negotiated or executed precedent acceptability.
extraction_prompt:
Normalize the provided clinical trial agreement text to the supplied canonical schema.

Process:
1. Read and resolve the definitions of Sponsor, Institution, Company, Funding Agency, and Sponsor-Investigator. Identify sponsor- versus investigator-initiated arrangements.
2. Locate semantically relevant clauses across all headings, schedules, appendices and cross-references. Use alias hints only to find candidates, never as proof of their legal meaning.
3. For each field, reason about obligations, party direction, negations, carve-outs, timing trigger, scope, conditions, and exceptions.
4. Return one JSON object with every canonical key, using {"value": ..., "status": "explicit|ambiguous|conditional|not_mentioned|not_applicable", "evidence": [{"quote": "verbatim text", "page": 1}], "note": "brief explanation"}.
5. Preserve exact enum values. Use JSON null with not_mentioned whenever the document does not establish a field. Do not fill missing fields from legal norms, adjacent clauses, or other templates.
6. If rights split by invention type, or multiple triggers produce different notice periods, mark conditional and describe each branch in note. Do not invent a single value.
7. no_substantive_change can be assessed only if BOTH old and new versions are supplied. For a single template, status=not_applicable and value=null.
8. Return machine-readable JSON only. Do not change canonical keys or categories.
